description: Compiling a template is not rendering into one, and the distinction is the whole rule. The safe route passes the caller's text as DATA to a fixed template file, which is the correct and far more common shape; the unsafe one builds the template text itself out of it. Escaping would not help here either, which is why this is its own context rather than a spelling of XSS: the five characters that make markup are not what a template engine interprets.

expected.note: the caller's text becomes part of the template source, and Jinja reaches the object graph from inside a template
